title: Agent-programs preinstall list for the carrier image (BUILD WAVE W6, C4)

source.method: Sizes are git blob bytes from the main tree at the tip above, summed per repo path. They are NOT baked-image sizes: the image lane (OpenCode) measures and replaces them with baked sizes. Nothing in this file claims a baked image, a boot, or a compile. Re-measured from 84fb161 after main moved mid-run (W1 contract landing + Aegis sweep files); only the Aegis anchors changed.
source.human_source: os-build/PREINSTALL.md (Del's order 2026-11-02) for the item list; agents/registry.json for the agent entries.

status: v1, queued with Pax, pending Milo gate-1. W6 fetch screen (rowan/kernel-w6) is kernel-side and is NOT part of this carrier manifest.
